subject: Matemática e suas Tecnologias
description_pt: Investigar conjuntos de dados relativos ao comportamento de duas variáveis numéricas, usando ou não tecnologias da informação, e, quando apropriado, levar em conta a variação e utilizar uma reta para descrever a relação observada.

components.description_pt: Organizar e exibir conjuntos de dados numéricos bivariados para investigação
components.description_en: Organize and display bivariate numerical data sets for investigation
components.cc_component_description: Understand that two-way tables can be used to to show associations in bivariate categorical data

components.description_pt: Identificar tendências e padrões em conjuntos de dados descrevendo duas variáveis numéricas
components.description_en: Identify trends and patterns in data sets describing two numerical variables
components.cc_component_description: Recognize and describe associations and trends in data from a two-way table

components.description_pt: Ajustar informalmente uma reta para modelar um conjunto de dados
components.description_en: Informally fit a straight line to model a data set
components.cc_component_description: Informally fit a straight line to model a data set

components.description_pt: Considerar variação ao interpretar a relação entre duas variáveis numéricas
components.description_en: Account for variation when interpreting the relationship between two numerical variables
components.cc_component_description: Represent data on two quantitative variables on a scatter plot and describe the relationship between them

cc_matches.description: Know that straight lines are widely used to model relationships between two quantitative variables. For scatter plots that suggest a linear association, informally fit a straight line, and informally assess the model fit by judging the closeness of the data points to the line.
Represent data on two quantitative variables on a scatter plot, and describe how the variables are related.

Understand that patterns of association can also be seen in bivariate categorical data by displaying frequencies and relative frequencies in a two-way table. Construct and interpret a two-way table summarizing data on two categorical variables collected from the same subjects. Use relative frequencies calculated for rows or columns to describe possible association between the two variables. *For example, collect data from students in your class on whether or not they have a curfew on school nights and whether or not they have assigned chores at home. Is there evidence that those who have a curfew also tend to have chores?*

Summarize categorical data for two categories in two-way frequency tables. Interpret relative frequencies in the context of the data (including joint, marginal, and conditional relative frequencies). Recognize possible associations and trends in the data.
